title: LCCS: The LCD / CRT Hybrid from JVC
summary: A Technology Connections video on JVC's LCCS, a display hybrid that cycles a color LCD shutter over a monochrome CRT to produce field-sequential color without dots or stripes. It builds on his earlier videos about analog TV and compatible color.
why: HN links it as a neat breakdown of an unusual CRT/LCD color technology.

quote.text: There's a neat breakdown of the tech on this YT channel
